note: All metadata below is based on published Copernicus CMEMS product documentation for GLOBAL_ANALYSISFORECAST_PHY_001_024. Items marked REQUIRES_VERIFICATION must be confirmed from the actual downloaded NetCDF-4 files during TASK-12B before any downstream processing.

variables.depth_levels_note: REQUIRES_VERIFICATION: Provider documentation indicates approximately 50 levels from surface (~0.494m) to approximately 5,727.917m. Exact level count and coordinate array must be read from actual downloaded file.
variables.notes: Full-depth expansion adds approximately 19 additional depth levels below the current 453.938m ceiling. The non-uniform depth LUT already supports this. Brick vertical strategy must be re-evaluated for ~50 levels.

variables.units_note: REQUIRES_VERIFICATION: Copernicus PHY_001_024 documentation indicates units of '1e-3' (dimensionless parts per thousand, equivalent to PSU numerically) or 'PSU'. The exact string in the NetCDF global attributes and variable attributes must be read from the actual file. Do NOT describe salinity as 'PSU' in any PROGRAM-02 output until the provider metadata string is confirmed. Use the exact provider string.
variables.depth_levels_note: REQUIRES_VERIFICATION: Expected same depth coordinate as thetao (same product, same grid). Must be confirmed from actual file.
variables.notes: Valid salinity can be 0.0 in freshwater-influenced coastal zones. The Uint16 missing code 65535 must not collide with any valid quantized salinity value. Quantization domain must cover 0.0 to ~40.0 safely. The term PSU is deprecated in oceanography; the SI-consistent unit is '1' (dimensionless). Use exact provider metadata string.

variables.depth_levels_note: REQUIRES_VERIFICATION: Expected same depth coordinate as thetao. Must be confirmed from actual file.
variables.grid_rotation_note: REQUIRES_VERIFICATION: The CF standard name 'eastward_sea_water_velocity' implies the component is on a geographic (lon/lat) grid aligned with true east. However, some CMEMS products store velocity on a rotated or curvilinear grid. The grid type (regular 1/12 degree lon/lat) must be confirmed from actual file coordinates and CF grid_mapping attribute before any vector decomposition is performed.
variables.notes: Valid velocity can be exactly 0.0 m/s. Uint16 quantization domain must cover symmetric range e.g. [-4.0, +4.0] or the actual observed range. Missing code 65535 must not collide with any valid value. Speed = sqrt(uo^2 + vo^2) must only be computed after confirming both components share the same grid and orientation. A missing uo with valid vo (or vice versa) must NEVER produce a valid speed.

variables.depth_levels_note: REQUIRES_VERIFICATION: Expected same depth coordinate as thetao. Must be confirmed from actual file.
variables.grid_rotation_note: REQUIRES_VERIFICATION: Same as uo. See uo notes.
variables.notes: Same constraints as uo. uo and vo must share the same validity mask cell-by-cell. If uo is masked and vo is valid at the same grid cell, both must be treated as masked for any vector computation.

variables.depth_levels_note: NOT APPLICABLE: zos is a 2D surface field with no depth dimension.
variables.notes: zos MUST be treated as a 2D time-varying surface field. It must NOT be extruded into a fake 3D volume. A separate surface-field rendering path is required. Valid zos can be 0.0 m. Uint16 quantization must cover a symmetric range around 0.0.
